display.purpose: Hero cycling headline word only. One word at a time, maximum presence.

headline.purpose: Section headings, hero static lines, footer CTA. Compressed leading.

title.purpose: Sub-section headings, service titles, process steps.

body.purpose: Subtitles, descriptions. Max 65–75ch. Only place where lines run long.

label.purpose: Nav links, eyebrows, stat labels, button text. All caps, extended tracking.

shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Navbar glass layer. Barely visible. Does not float.

shadows.name: glass-deep
shadows.purpose: AI Strategist panel. Long tail ambient.

shadows.name: chromatic-pulse
shadows.purpose: Nova orb at rest. Expands to 80px / 0.6 on pulse peak.

shadows.name: inset-depth
shadows.purpose: Footer container. Carves rather than floats.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions, navbar clip-path, mobile dropdown.

motion.name: ease-out-smooth
motion.purpose: Entrance animations, section reveals, count-up fades.

motion.name: ease-spring-expo
motion.purpose: Trust badge entrances. Fast snap, long tail.

motion.name: ease-spring-bounce
motion.purpose: Star rating scale-in only. The one permitted spring overshoot.

motion.name: spring-lenis
motion.purpose: AboutUs scroll-driven opacity spring. Smooth catch.

components.name: LiquidMetal Button — Primary
components.description: WebGL fragment shader metallic pill. The system's signature interaction. Bold and ceremonial.

components.name: CTA Button — Footer
components.description: Solid fill CTA. Used in footer and section callouts. Not metallic — direct and decisive.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; height: 64px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #e5192a; border: 2px solid #e5192a; padding: 0 40px; font-family: 'Clash Display', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background-color: #ffffff; color: #e5192a; transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(229,25,42,0.30); }

narrative.overview:
This is the design language of a studio that has already decided it is the best. Not cocky — sovereign. The black canvas is not chosen for atmosphere; it is the absolute baseline that makes the Lacquer Red (#e5192a) land with the force of a decree. Every surface, every animation, every typographic choice answers one question: does this prove we are world-class, or does it waste the frame?

The type is Clash Display, used exclusively, at every size. There is no body font and no serif contrast — this is a monolingual typographic system, which is unusual and correct. The voice is singular. The spacing is deliberate: sections breathe; headings compress. The ratio between a label at 11px and a display line at 11rem is not a scale — it is a canyon, and that canyon is the hierarchy.

Motion is cinematic, not decorative. The curtain card that slides away on scroll, the sticky hero that sections scroll over, the 3D carousel spinning the portfolio on loop: these are not features, they are demonstrations. The site is the pitch. Every interaction is proof.
keyCharacteristics: Single font family, entire scale from 11px to 11rem
Pure black canvas; color is signal, never decoration
Lacquer Red deployed with precision: CTAs, accents, cycling words, trust numbers
Sovereign Gold held in reserve: used rarely to mark a moment of triumph or distinction
Cinematic scroll architecture over conventional section stacking
Motion vocabulary: exponential ease-out, never bounce or elastic
Bold and ceremonial interactions: every button, badge, and transition is a statement

rules.name: The Lacquer Rule
rules.body: Red is a statement, not a tint. It appears where the eye should land next. Every other instance of red asks: is this the most important thing on screen right now? If not, remove it.

rules.name: The Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Sovereign Gold is forbidden in default content. It exists for one purpose: to mark the extraordinary. Treat it the way a general treats a medal — issue it rarely so it retains meaning.

rules.name: The One Light Surface Rule
rules.body: The Light Steel surface (#eceff3) exists for one architectural purpose: to create a register break between dense dark sections. Never place it adjacent to another light surface.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Clash Display is the only typeface. Never introduce a second family for body contrast, pull quotes, or code. Use weight and scale differential to create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Canyon Rule
rules.body: The display-to-label size ratio is not a comfortable scale — it is a canyon. Do not introduce intermediate sizes that would fill the gap. The contrast between 11rem and 11px is the hierarchy. Protect it.

rules.name: The Tonal Canvas Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is expressed through background tonal lift (Void → Obsidian → Carbon → Charcoal), not drop shadows. Drop shadows appear only in three defined contexts: ambient blur, chromatic glow, and inset carving.

rules.name: The No Decorative Glow Rule
rules.body: Chromatic glow is reserved for the primary accent — the Nova orb and active CTA states. Never apply colored glows to section backgrounds, cards, or text elements. If it looks like a gaming PC, it's wrong.

dos: Do use Lacquer Red (#e5192a) only where the eye should land next. It is a directive, not a tint.
Do let the black canvas breathe. Negative space is not empty — it is the stage.
Do use exponential ease-out curves for all state transitions. The motion should feel like a confident decision, not a performance.
Do introduce the Light Steel surface (#eceff3) only as an architectural register break — one section at a time.
Do keep body copy capped at 65–75ch and 18px. Founders read fast; give them a clean line.
Do hold the Sovereign Gold (#f0c917) in reserve for singular moments of distinction.
Do make every interaction statement-level. Buttons are ceremonial.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — disable orb pulse, carousel spin, and entrance stagger; preserve hierarchy.
Do use uppercase Clash Display with tracking 0.12–0.15em for all labels, eyebrows, and nav text.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on any surface.
Don't use background-clip: text with any gradient. No gradient text.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Blur is reserved for functional layers: navigation and the AI panel.
Don't build identical card grids. Icon + heading + text repeated in a 3-column grid is the most reliable way to produce AI-slop output.
Don't use the hero-metric template: big stat, small label, supporting copy row, gradient accent.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Clash Display is the only voice.
Don't add a colored drop shadow to anything that isn't the Nova orb.
Don't place Sovereign Gold adjacent to Lacquer Red in the same visual element. They compete; neither wins.
Don't make the light-steel section feel like a separate website.
